programmes.title: Mission: Impossible III
programmes.description: The film is the third instalment of the Mission Impossible series in which retired super-spy Ethan Hunt comes back to active spy life to battle a ruthless arms dealer. He must keep his identity a secret as his girlfriend doesn't know he is a spy. Hunt assembles his team--his old friend Luther Strickell, transportation expert Declan, background operative Zhen, and fresh recruit Lindsey--to travel the globe pursuing Davian and rescue Hunt's love, Julia.

programmes.title: L'armata Brancaleone
programmes.description: In un Medioevo in cui i valori cavallereschi rimangono solo ideali, il cavaliere fanfarone Brancaleone da Norcia raduna un manipolo di miserabili per andare in Puglia a reclamare il feudo di Aurocastro. Il loro viaggio tortuoso procederà tra le peripezie più varie, colpi di scena, incontri esilaranti e situazioni grottesche.
